question: Emit a signed in-toto-style provenance attestation stating which commit, builder identity, and build parameters produced the artifact digest, and implement verify-on-install. Signing uses an owner-held key; the unit must never create, rotate, or regenerate a key — it consumes one the owner provides.

residual_unknowns.claim: Production signing still requires the owner to place an Ed25519 PEM at PLUGIN_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY. This unit implements consume-and-verify, not key custody.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Call attest() without PLUGIN_ATTESTATION_SIGNING_KEY; expect OWNER_KEY_REQUIRED.

residual_unknowns.claim: Trust policy (warn/deny/allow) is IMP-0078; detached marketplace signature format is IMP-0077. This unit is the build-side producer plus verify-on-install.

retry.policy: no automatic retry on a signing failure; escalate to the owner
